This article is a stub. Dexstar Communications is a distributor of
[Swiss Timing](swiss-timing.md) products in Eastern Canada, based in Pointe-Claire, Quebec, whose
web pages are hosted by [Integrated Sports Systems](integrated-sports-systems.md) and which sells
the [DC 204 Sports Timer](../equipment/swimming/relay-judging/dc-204-sports-timer.md).

See the [vendors overview](index.md) for the other organizations the wiki covers.
